problem.title: Looking for advice on how to work with json files that sort data in atypical format
problem.description: I'm working with a json file in R that seems to have a somewhat odd format for a class assignment in both R and Python: { "data": [ { "British Columbia": "BC", "BC": "4.63" }, { "Alberta": "AB", "AB": "4.15" }, { "Ontario": "ON", "ON": "13.6" }, { "Manitoba": "MB", "MB": "1.28" }, { "Saskatchewan": "SK", "SK": "1.1" } ] } I'm iterating over this in R in a very similar way to Python (which worked successfully), but this approach in R appears to be flat wrong when I'm binding/appending the numeric
